about: BO3 scorestreaks earned in Skyrim. Earn points (streak_points) without dying; spend with the streak keys (settings). Models, sounds and announcer lines come from the player's BO3 copy. Skyrim stand-ins are used only for effects BO3 cannot supply (fire/explosion visuals): that is flagged in the listing.

announcer.desc: Where its voice line comes from
